reasons.claim: 1.02 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified. Completed felling (2007) overlaps 0.2 ha (19.7%), below the 50% threshold, so not ALREADY_FELLED.

Two eligible species recorded within 250 m: Alectoria sarmentosa (VU lichen) and Skeletocutis brevispora (VU fungus). Both are site-bound, forest-associated and have felling-relevant threats (lack of continuity forest, old trees or dead wood, ground disturbance in forestry). Both nearest records are 149 m away, from 2018, with 250 m uncertainty.

Three site-bound forest NT species are also within 250 m: Hermanssonia centrifuga (109 m, 2024, 5 m uncertainty), Bryoria nadvornikiana and Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum (149 m, 2018). They support the picture but are not eligible species.
Recording effort is adequate: 101 records and 61 species within 1000 m versus county median 66 (64th percentile). 6 records within 250 m, none inside the polygon.

uncertainties: The VU records are from 2018 with 250 m uncertainty, equal to the ring size and larger than the site's 57 m radius, so their exact position relative to the polygon is uncertain.
The 2007 partial felling overlaps about 20% of the polygon, so part of the stand has already been disturbed.
not_established: It is not established that any listed species occupies the polygon now.
No records inside the polygon, so occupancy of the felling site is not shown.
The site's legal protection status is not established; Red List categories are not legal protection.
next_action: Human ecologist should review the site before felling begins, ideally with a field check for the lichens and wood fungi recorded 109-149 m away, and look at the older felling overlap to see what stand remains.
